name: COMP_034
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (68%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
The 90% conformal set spans Benign, InSitu, and Invasive [F1]; simulated frozen-section margins read positive [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 68%, InSitu 17%, Benign 13%, Normal 2% | Favors Invasive; others remain plausible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot exclude InSitu or Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 93% reliability, 94th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Unflagged quality, but atypical image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Both backbones pick same class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive, 3/5 InSitu (86%–87% similarity) [F5] | Split between Invasive and InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.41) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · High score (-0.27) opposes invasion [F3]; 18/20, caption inconsistent · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low-lobule score (+0.20) favors invasion [F4]; 0/20 check · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low-confinement score (+0.16) favors invasion; 12/20 check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-risk deletion drops invasive probability beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197; faithful).
- **Concepts**: Deletion matches noise (+0.0008, CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); mitoses, normal lobules, and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is in situ (like 87%-similar BACH_0351) or benign; only unvalidated concepts favor invasion.
- High OOD (94th percentile) or composite simulated frozen-section artifacts distort classification and margins (error AUROC 70%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 4** (98%, 93%, 89% risk): verify stromal invasion versus in situ or benign lesion.
2. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7**: check superior (430 um), lateral (215 um), and medial (108 um) margins.
3. **Regions 5, 6, 10**: check mitoses and duct confinement; consider deeper levels (stains blocked; cells disabled).
